candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of stored owner, altering returned owner based on caller.
Change paused() to always return the inverse of the stored paused flag (returns !paused instead of paused).
If the stored per-token royalty recipient is the zero address, return a different default royaltyBPS (1000 instead of 500) while keeping recipient as royaltyRecipient; otherwise unchanged.
Return default royaltyBPS of 1000 (10%) instead of 500 when no per-token config exists.
If uninitialized, return default configuration instead of reverting.
When token has no specific recipient, return royaltyRecipient but with 0 BPS (no royalty).
